title: Injection
summary: An injective function never sends two different inputs to the same output.

context.note: This node belongs to one explicit foundational presentation; alternate foundations may encode it differently.

assumptions.text: The declared functions context is fixed.

content.plain: An injective function never sends two different inputs to the same output.
content.exact: f:X→Y is injective iff ∀x₁,x₂∈X, f(x₁)=f(x₂) implies x₁=x₂.
content.example: n↦2n is injective from ℤ to ℤ.
content.caveat: Injectivity does not require every codomain value to be hit.
